issues.description: The problem statement specifies a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but both the provided template/solution code use the name computeMealCost(Meal) for the equivalent static method. This name mismatch between specification and code can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to refer to computeMealCost(Meal): int everywhere, or (B) rename the method in the template and solution from computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice and update all call sites (e.g., Main) accordingly. Ensure the UML and textual description match the code.

issues.description: The problem statement specifies a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to compute a meal's cost, but both the template usage and the solution implementation use the identifier computeMealCost(Meal). This mismatch between the documented method name and the actual code (and template examples) can confuse students when mapping the requirement to the provided code and when implementing or calling the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Either rename computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice in the code (SealSaloon.java and any references in Main.java) or update the problem statement to refer to computeMealCost. Ensure the method remains static and returns an int as specified.
